title: Recording opening and interviewee's name
summary: The interviewer restarts the machine, asks for her name and the date, June 1, 1967; she mentions her grandson.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: . This is the same machine we had before. We can't buy a new one. Can I get your name down again?
You want to start it with my name?
Oh yes, give me your name. The Redder Roller 11.
You should have put that roll on. Roller is my favorite grandson, but he don't love them all. He's doing too swell to worry about his grandma now. She's the one that inspired him all the way through.
And let's see, the day is... June 1st. June 1st, 1967. And where are we?
